roster.name: MiAIRR (Minimal Information about an AIRR-seq study)
roster.description: A minimal-information reporting standard for AIRR sequencing studies specifying required study, sample and data-processing metadata to allow meaningful interpretation and reuse of repertoire datasets (study reporting metadata).

roster.name: AIRR Repertoire Schema (AIRR Data Model)
roster.description: A machine-readable metadata schema describing the 'Repertoire' object — study, subject, sample, processing, sequencing-run and linking conventions — used to represent AIRR study- and sample-level metadata and file structure (on-disk and API object definitions).

roster.name: AIRR Rearrangement Schema
roster.description: A schema for annotated V(D)J rearrangements (sequence-level metadata) specifying fields for gene calls, junctions, CDRs, identifiers and links back to the containing Repertoire and processing metadata.

roster.name: Germline & Genotype Schema
roster.description: Schema definitions for germline gene sets and genotype/allele metadata (GermlineSet, GenotypeSet), including identifiers, sequence records and provenance for inferred/documented alleles.

roster.name: AIRR Data Representation / Formats
roster.description: Specifications for on-disk/in-transit representations (TSV/JSON/YAML Data File formats, file-structure and field definitions) and example templates for submitting AIRR metadata to archives (SRA/BioSample/BioProject).

roster.name: AIRR Data Commons (ADC) API
roster.description: A programmatic query/download API standard (ADC API) that defines query language, endpoints, queryable fields and response formats for searching and retrieving AIRR objects from compliant repositories.
